## Scope

Describe the smallest product change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Versioned fixture added or unchanged behavior justified
- [ ] Unit tests pass
- [ ] Self-test passes
- [ ] Package verification passes
- [ ] Release validator passes
- [ ] No secrets, private paths, prompts, outputs, or generated residue

## Product boundary

Explain how the change preserves content-free receipts, advisory-only rate telemetry, valid changed work, and local-action-only enforcement.
